title: The Hodge Obstruction to Escape-Proof Therapy: A Discrete-Hodge No-Go Result and Safety-Game Benchmark
description: A theoretical and synthetic-computational preprint examining a proposed Hodge-curl obstruction for antimicrobial safety games. It establishes the definitional no-go that edge effects defined as differences of a static scalar fitness potential are exact gradients, then provides a reproducible finite-state robust viability-game benchmark. Simulations are synthetic and do not demonstrate biological efficacy, escape-proof therapy, or clinical safety. No DOI is assigned by this metadata file.
